steps.run: (() => { const [red, green, blue] = getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor.match(/[0-9]+/g).map(Number); return { darkPhoneFits: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= 360, darkThemeApplied: (red + green + blue) / 3 < 64, phoneMessageVisible: document.querySelector('textarea[aria-label=Message]')?.checkVisibility() === true }; })()

(() => { const [red, green, blue] = getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor.match(/[0-9]+/g).map(Number); return { lightPhoneFits: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= 360, lightThemeApplied: matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches && !document.documentElement.dataset.theme && (red + green + blue) / 3 > 192 }; })()

({ phoneSidebarOpens: document.querySelector('nav[aria-label="Projects and chats"]')?.inert === false && document.querySelector('nav[aria-label="Projects and chats"]').getBoundingClientRect().left >= 0 && document.querySelector('nav[aria-label="Projects and chats"]').getBoundingClientRect().right <= 360, phoneSidebarFits: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= 360 })

(() => { const dialog = document.querySelector('dialog[aria-label=Settings]'); const box = dialog?.getBoundingClientRect(); return { phoneSettingsOpen: dialog?.open === true && dialog.checkVisibility() && dialog.innerText.includes('Logins'), phoneSettingsFit: !!box && box.left >= 0 && box.right <= 360 && document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= 360 }; })()
